PLAY-REC-D274-WTR-CLEARANCE-TERMS-001
Player's exact in-character negotiation after the successful Day274 four-worker safe ventilation rescue, at cutting outer muster approximately1:45PM: "We can help, but it’s a risk and we need some funds to help. Else the commonwealth can send some people once the bureaucracy finds some time". This is a CONDITION on offering to clear the separate still-hazardous annex, not acceptance to enter the mine or promise to fight for free; does not specify a fee amount. Independent local road officer WTR-O acknowledges previous rescue but truthfully has no authority to promise private combat contract, cash bounty, treasury funds or foreign property; offers permissible continued worksite equipment access and factual written acknowledgment of actual aid only. Forewoman WTR-F affirms that armed clearance entails risk and compensation request is reasonable, and plans to keep the now-empty dangerous annex closed while obtaining authorized response and working the alternative aggregate supply if party declines. She does not invent a personal monetary reward or compel the party to clear. Cirren agrees the workers are safe and optional risk should not be presumed; Fenar likes combat but accepts interest in being paid. The officer independently accepts that V can leave without penalty, notes common road stays open; he can refer a hazardous site to proper state services without guaranteeing response time or secretly spawning an escort. No rolls needed: persuasion cannot cause an official to spend unauthorized funds. No negotiated payment, contract, conditional entry, monetary amount, fame reward, worksite clearance, dice, combat, HP/resource/gear/horse/timing change. V has NOT declined or accepted the UNPAID dangerous clearance; it awaits the player's next decision. All four original rescued workers are alive in safety, cave hazard untouched, site legally restricted.

PLAY-REC-D274-275-LEAVE-CUTTING-001
Player exact direction after local officer declined to fund optional hazardous annex clearance: "ok then we move on". This declines further unpaid optional chamber/annex clearance, not the already successful four-worker rescue. Day274 about13:45-14:00 V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar leave WTR outer muster, worksite staff WTR-F and WTR-O remain independently responsible for closing/restricting dangerous unentered gallery, alternative aggregate supply, eventual official handling; neither foe was fought/seen, and no offscreen clearance has occurred. Crew's previously loaned worksite ropes/lanterns returned intact at departure, no ongoing personal custody, cost, fee or bounty. Four rescued workers safe, no future V obligation/promise. Intact V four-horse coach returns ~1hour down the established two-mile graded north spur to the main patrolled western Veyr commercial road in mid-afternoon and continues east toward Caer Veylan/Eastwatch without entering either city or crossing new border. Day274 daytime occurrence d100FACE17 vs heavily patrolled day01–07 was already resolved during WTR approach, NOT rerolled. Night274 exposed camp alongside patrolled road: genuine executed system Python secrets d100 FACE14 vs tier night01–03 = NO encounter; one quiet qualifying wilderness overnight Short Rest, no damage/spells/special feature expenditure or HD spending; weighted Long Rest progress2/6→3/6 by dawn275 (no full Long Rest). Day275 morning once-only ordinary consumption 3 ration-person-days for Mara/Cirren/Fenar and4 horse-feed animal-days for four healthy horses: stores rations9→6, feed12→8. Day275 heavily patrolled road daytime encounter genuine Python secrets d100 FACE33 vs01–07 = NO event. Continue ordinary safe travel through western Veyr countryside until Day275 late afternoon, still en route toward Caer Veylan and Eastwatch, no known destination arrival, surveyed mileage or new quest/staged encounter. No Day275 exposed night roll or additional overnight/rest/food debit yet. Party V48/48 HP HD7/7 full combat/psi resources, purse1137gp7sp6cp; Fenar59/59 HP HD4/6, Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6; Cirren51/51 HP HD6/6 L1 4/4 L2 3/3 L3 3/3, Mara healthy. Four owned healthy horses and intact coach, Long Rest3/6, rations6 person-days and feed8 animal-days. V next action unchosen; no forced early re-supply, no automatic monetary purchase.

Four workers rescued and forewoman/officer controlling closed hazard. Rest progress3/6 after quiet night274; carried provisions6 ration-person-days/feed8 horse animal-days, personal purse1137gp7sp6cp. Day275 daytime roll33 quiet, night275 has not happened. Player next travel/camp/possible supply stop decision unchosen.
